Radian is a [[unit of measurement]] used to measure [[angle]]s.

[[File:Radian.png]]

In any [[circle#In the Euclidean plane|Euclidean circle]], if the length of an arc is equal to the radius of the circle $r$, then the [[circle#central angle|central angle]] of that arc always measures exactly $1 \ \mathrm{rad}$
